title: Icipfuzo co mu cumba ceranda
intro: Uca winjira mu rusengero rutekanye, ubona umusavyi wa Allah yihebeye Imana ahagaze mu gusenga. Amaboko yabo araduzwa, amaso yabo araduzwa, umutima wabo ufise icipfuzo camaze ubuzima bwabo bwose. Ni nde uwo mutima wihangana, ukwizigira kwiwe kuri Allah kutarigeze guhungabana?
clues: Naramaze imyaka myinshi mu gusenga no mu gusenga, mbona ibitangaro vyakomeje ukwizera kwanje.
Nahawe inshingano yo kwitwararika umutima mutoyi uhezagiwe mu rusengero.
Uko nagenda ndakura, umubabaro wanje ukomeye ni uko nta mwana nari mfise, kuko umugore wanje yari ingumba kandi twempi twari twashize mu zabukuru.
Narasenze Umukama wanje ngo ampe uwuzokurikira mu muryango wanje bwite, umuntu azobandanya iragi ry’ubuhanuzi.
Igihe nari mpagaze mu kibanza c’amasengesho, abamarayika barampamagara bati: ‘Allah araguha inkuru nziza’, nanje ndakubitwa n’ubwoba n’agahinda.
Nabwiwe ko nzovyara umuhungu yitwa Yahya, izina ritari bwigere ryitwa umuntu n’umwe, kandi nk’ikimenyetso nzomara imisi itatu ntavugana n’abantu.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Ubugumba n’ubusaza mu gihe wipfuza umuragwa w’umugororotsi .
trial.answer: Ubugumba n’ubusaza mu gihe wipfuza umuragwa w’umugororotsi .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Yemeye umuhungu w’umugororotsi yongera aravuga inyuma y’imisi itatu acereje .
Hahawe ubwami buhambaye no kugenzura umuyaga .
outcome.answer: Yemereye umuhungu w’umugororotsi yongera aravuga inyuma y’imisi itatu acereje .

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
